states.effect: While this card is in your hand, the Build Satellite Tower action costs 1 fewer Supply cube. The card is not discarded to use it. Scratching reveals the Companion Technician.

rules: Yellow Player card for Kinshasa. Not a port. No anchor on the compass.
One SEARCH box. State 2 is the scratched face. State side A is the unchanged player-card back.
Companion Technician: when you do Build Satellite Tower, spend 1 fewer Supply cube if this card is in your hand.
notes: Card id 10702. Scratch state card id 10718.
Printed code P7-03b stays on the scratched face.
The recon report puts this Player card in the Player discard pile when the package is opened. There is no second Kinshasa Player card.
No bullseye sticker circle is printed. The scratch box covers the center of the card.
